tools.name: ispringlearn_list_users
tools.description: List learners and admins of the iSpring Learn account, with profile fields, status and department. Filter by department, group, login, email or user id. GET /users/v2.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_user
tools.description: Get the full profile of one user by user id. GET /user/{userId}/v2.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_user_profile_fields
tools.description: List the profile fields of the account (built-in and custom), to know which fields a user profile has. GET /user/profile/fields.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_roles
tools.description: List the user roles of the account (owner, administrators, custom roles). GET /role.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_groups
tools.description: List the groups of the account. GET /groups.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_group
tools.description: Get one group by id. GET /group/{groupId}.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments (organization tree) of the account. Optional filter by department code. GET /department.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_department
tools.description: Get one department by id. GET /department/{departmentId}.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_content
tools.description: List content items (courses, trainings, learning tracks) of the account. Filter by content item ids or content types. GET /contents.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_content_item
tools.description: Get one content item by id. GET /content/{contentId}.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_content_final_statuses
tools.description: List the possible final statuses of a content item (for example completed, passed, failed). GET /content/{contentId}/final_statuses.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_course_modules
tools.description: List the modules of one course. GET /course/{courseId}/modules.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_enrollments
tools.description: List enrollments (learner assigned to a course) with status, progress and due dates. Filter by course, learner or enrollment id. GET /enrollments.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_enrollment
tools.description: Get the details of one enrollment by id. GET /enrollment/{enrollmentId}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ispringlearn_list_departments" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ispringlearn_list_users · Public sink: ispringlearn_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ispringlearn_list_users · Public sink: ispringlearn_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
